metadata.description: Live-captured POST /api/mdm/profiles/platforms/winrt/create against UEM 26.2.0.0, 2026-07-30 -- re-verified with clean v2 header post-fix. Response is a bare int (created ProfileId); the real captured id was hand-replaced with 68912. Real-wire finding: this create returns HTTP 201, unlike apple/appleosx create which both return 200 for the same bare-int response shape -- status code is not uniform across platforms for this operation family. Also note: mock-capture's default --swagger-dir (internal-source/internal-source, the raw vendored snapshot) does not declare this path at all in any of its 4 mdm swagger files -- it only exists in internal-source/mdmv2.json (the source actually used by codegen). --swagger-dir internal-source was passed explicitly to get a correct (still fully automatic, no --accept-version override) v2 resolution; see report for detail.
